sections.Profile:
"Red Shoes" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by United Manufacturing Co. in November 1950. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and six kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Ballet, Single Player, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme
